People for Palmer Park Thursday Ride

Detroit, MI · Palmer Park

People for Palmer Park Thursday Ride is a social and road group ride in Detroit, MI. It meets every Thursday, May 7–Oct 29, 2026; meet 6:00 pm, roll 6:30 pm sharp, starting at Palmer Park Community House lot. Pace: fitness pace, 10–15 mph.

About the People for Palmer Park Thursday Ride group ride

A one-hour loop out of Palmer Park through the Apartment District, Golf Club neighborhood, Ferndale, New Center and Boston Edison. Led by a park volunteer. Join for part or all of it.
